rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that lasts only a short time, such as a pleasure or feeling.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hoi1 sam1 hou2 dyun2 zaam6

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing physically passing through or by, rather than staying there.

example.english: I’m just a transient visitor passing through, so I won’t come in.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 lou6 gwo3 m4 jap6 lei4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when something is passed from one person or place to another, not when someone merely passes through.

example.english: The news was transient, passing from my mum to me before spreading through the village.
example.traditional: 個消息由阿媽傳到我度，好快成村都知喇。
example.jyutping: go3 siu1 sik1 jau4 aa3 maa1 cyun4 dou3 ngo5 dou6 hou2 faai3 sing4 cyun1 dou1 zi1 laa3
